The '''Mobile Mining Barge I''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[mining barge]] developed by [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. Designed as an answer to the problem of [[Mining/Legends|mining]] on the [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]]-prone [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Lish V]], the entire vehicle floated on a [[repulsorlift field]].
